about_short_description.short_description: UPFRONT is a B2B finance platform that maximizes cash flow for MENA's small and medium-sized enterprises.

product.name: UPFRONT Platform
product.description: A cloud-based B2B finance platform for MENA SMEs that combines receivables automation, payment orchestration, financial analytics, and working-capital management.

product.name: Accounts Receivable Automation
product.description: Software that automates invoicing, payment reminders, collections, payment tracking, reconciliation, and receivables reporting to help businesses manage outstanding customer balances.

product.name: Receivables Financing
product.description: A working-capital service that enables businesses to request funding against outstanding invoices and access cash before customers settle their balances.

product.name: Embedded Payments and Payment Orchestration
product.description: Integrated payment functionality that lets businesses collect invoice payments through cards, bank-based methods, direct debit, and other digital payment options.

product.name: B2B Buy Now, Pay Later
product.description: A business-to-business payment solution that allows eligible commercial buyers to defer or schedule payment for purchases while sellers receive a more structured collection experience.
